page_title: AI Rap Video Generator From Photos | EasyRapVideo

sources.entry: EasyRap - Creates short rap music videos from one or two photos using paid credits. #paid

summary.name: EasyRapVideo
summary.one_liner: EasyRapVideo is a web-based AI tool that turns one or two photos into a 5, 10 or 15-second MP4 rap video with AI vocals and music.
use_cases: Making a personalized birthday rap video for a friend
Creating a friendly roast video from a photo
Turning a pet photo into a rap performance
Making a two-person rap battle video
Producing a short rap clip for social media posts
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes one or two photos plus an optional idea or short lyrics and generates a short rap video. Users pick a style (Street Rap, Trap, Old School, Funny Rap or Anime Rap) and optionally one of 20 scenes across those styles. Video length is 5, 10 or 15 seconds, with aspect ratios 9:16, 16:9, 4:3 or 1:1. With audio on, it creates AI rap vocals and music in an MP4; audio-only or MP3 export is not offered. Lite plans request 480p and HD requests 720p, and generation is tracked in a My Videos section.
notable: Five rap styles and twenty optional scenes
Credit-based pricing with Lite, Standard and HD quality tiers
Optional silent video when audio is turned off on Standard and HD
New accounts get 20 free credits for one 5-second Lite video
caveats: Paid monthly subscriptions ($19.90 to $199 per month) are needed for most videos; the free allowance covers only one 5-second Lite video
Exact lyrics and lip sync are not guaranteed
Music-file uploads, Suno/Udio links and voice cloning are not supported
Real people in photos must be consenting adults and you must have image permission
